notes: Gusfield's algorithm performs exactly `vcount - 1` calls to `st_mincut` (FL-018), each backed by Dinic max-flow. The K_n suite shows the expected dense scaling: time grows roughly as n^3 (n max-flow calls on a network with O(n^2) edges, each Dinic running in O(V*E)), confirmed by the 10.9µs (n=8) → 2.2ms (n=64) step ratio of ~200× over an 8× increase in n. The cycle C_n suite is the per-call overhead floor: each Dinic finds a 2-edge cut in one BFS pass, so the cost is dominated by the n-1 calls' setup; the 21µs (n=16) → 67ms (n=1024) ratio of ~3200× over 64× n confirms the n^2 floor (st_mincut is O(V+E) per call on a cycle, repeated n times). No clippy lints; no allocation in the inner loop beyond what st_mincut requires.
